facts.text: Gallaudet University is the world's only bilingual university for Deaf and hard of hearing students, using American Sign Language and English for instruction and communication.

sources.title: Gallaudet University's 2026 U.S. News & World Report rankings announced
sources.quote: These national rankings underscore Gallaudet's unique mission as the world's only bilingual university for Deaf and hard of hearing students

sources.title: MSCHE Institutional Overview - Gallaudet University
sources.quote: A bilingual learning environment, featuring American Sign Language and English, that provides full access for all students to learning and communication.
